618-1916-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

240-5470-7272-8201.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-7272-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5741-6791-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5254-6797-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6797-8122.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
5254-6797-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

539-728-3249-4242.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-4242.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-7492--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Arnyn ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6798-7452.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

252-4231-5394-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-6791.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

851-3129-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1394-2060-5231-7038-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1394-2060-5231-7038-7803.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Brad Boimler.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Brad Boimler.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

3375-4268-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4268-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-7010-7737.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7697.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brood Butcher, adding {C}{C}.
When Brood Butcher dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Brood Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Brood Butcher enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

423-433-1437-3257--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-3257--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5231-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6797-7200.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1012-2438-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-2438-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

372-3603-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3603-7095.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4038-4474-7008.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

640-4050-5010-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

1734-3817-5256.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-2854-3518-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1661-2854-3518-4574.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

618-3580-5921.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-5617-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

783-1399-1606-4452.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2131-2541-4389.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill a card and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Grave-Shell Scarab.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2921-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-5631.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1618-3528-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-3528-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Rise of the Eldrazi and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-3528-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Rise of the Eldrazi and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Rise of the Eldrazi, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Rise of the Eldrazi and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Rise of the Eldrazi and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-3528-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

1445-2921-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1669-2511-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2608-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2608-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Derevi.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Put the Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

944-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2429-3193-3809.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-3809.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2962-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
2962-3525-4508.description:
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat.

813-892-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
813-892-4276.description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Turnabout and Sublime Epiphany from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
You may also select any of Sublime Epiphany's other modes.

2034-2732-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
2034-2732-4013.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two other nontoken creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers twice, exiling the sacrificed creatures from your graveyard.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all creature cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

679-2275.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2275.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
